services.desc: Host your next live show, holiday party, private event, or corporate gathering in one of our gorgeous rental spaces at The Brackendale Art Gallery - a stunning Sea-to-Sky venue surrounded by art, nature, and mountain views. From holiday parties to weddings, conferences, and art shows, our versatile rental spaces offer a one-of-a-kind Squamish setting for memorable events of every kind. Offering five unique venues across our grounds, each designed to inspire connection and create unforgettable experiences.
